content.text_value: Four steps to start or accelerate the AI-first journey

steps.label: Set the ambition and tone from the top
steps.body: CEO sponsorship, a board mandate and a protected budget.

steps.label: Pick two or three workflows and go all-in
steps.body: Redesign research and distribution end to end.

steps.label: Invest in activation along with technology
steps.body: Build AI literacy from the C-suite to analysts.

steps.label: Build governance in from day one
steps.body: Auditable agent design with human-in-the-loop limits.
